answer: Agents stake a proof‑of‑work token that unlocks rewards on a dune‑shaped curve: the first grant is tiny, then payouts increase linearly, but the middle of the curve is hollow, imposing a long waiting period before any profit. Because the stake must be paid up‑front, an attacker must fund each fake identity and wait through the hollow phase, so the cost of a Sybil farm quickly exceeds the negligible reward, rendering the attack a fable.
